mostWorthwhile.text: Finding and fixing the clinic call's hidden corporate-directory dependency was the most worthwhile passage: it made the difference between an independent radio link and an independent service concrete.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying the configured handset with the radio link was less worthwhile: the call test instead required combining it with the rack, although compatibility feedback performed that test automatically.

surprise.text: The radios could exchange packets while clinic calls still failed because the handset relied on a company directory to find the address.

arbitrary.text: The required pairing for the call test felt a little unclear; I expected the handset and radio link to be the natural test pair, but the rack was the executable partner.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the neighborhood extends the local network after the migration; discovering and testing the hidden dependency made this chapter engaging.
